CREATIVE ARTS — MOCK EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Wind Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Wind Musical Instruments.
   B. Practise Wind Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Wind Musical Instruments.
   D. Damage equipment used for Wind Musical Instruments.

2. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Red, blue, and yellow

   C. Black, white, and grey
   D. Brown, pink, and gold

   A. Disrupt classmates during Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .

   C. Practise Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts  with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .

15. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the costume
   B. The speed of the music
   C. Only the volume
   D. The ticket price

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Puppetry and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Descant Recorder and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
